verdict.rationale: First-party docs say that once a goal or task is set, Muse keeps working on a schedule and in response to events, taking next steps after you close the app (muse-docs-20, muse-docs-26). It runs on its own VM with a terminal, tracks work in a Goals tab, and returns to you through notifications, approval cards and a full audit trail (muse-docs-1, muse-docs-5, muse-docs-10, muse-docs-13, muse-docs-24, muse-docs-27); muse-docs-22 gives multi-step examples like planning and booking a whole trip. A community stress test found the agent control plane timing out under heavy load, but that is a load limit rather than a contradiction of the capability. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of background multi-step task completion, and evidence of reliability under load.
